IT & INFORMATION SECURITY POLICIES
Enterprise Security Incident Response Guide & SRE
Runbook
Severity Matrix, Incident Commander Roles, Triage, and Containment Playbook
Classification: Confidential
Version: 3.5
Owner: Security Operations Center (SOC)
Standard: Google SRE / NIST 800-61
1. Framework and Philosophy
The Apex Security Incident Response Guide outlines the standard operational procedures for identifying, triaging,
containing, eradicating, and recovering from cybersecurity incidents and operational outages. Adapted from Google Site
Reliability Engineering (SRE) incident response practices and NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 2, Apex champions a blameless
incident response culture focused on rapid remediation and systemic learning.

3. Incident Response Lifecycle and Action Steps
Preparation: Maintain pre-configured incident bridge channels, forensic toolkits (LiME, Volatility, AWS Athena log
queries), and on-call rosters via PagerDuty.
Identification & Declaration: Any engineer or automated monitor detecting anomalous behavior pages the on-call
team. The responder declares the incident in Slack: /incident declare "Suspected API credential leak" .
Containment (Immediate Mitigation):
Revoke compromised access keys and invalidate active SSO sessions.
Modify AWS Security Groups to isolate affected EC2 instances into a quarantine VPC.
Apply WAF rate-limiting rules to block attacking IP subnets.
Eradication & Forensics: Capture memory dumps and snapshot EBS volumes for forensic analysis before
terminating compromised compute instances. Patch the root vulnerability.
Recovery & Verification: Redeploy verified clean workloads from immutable CI/CD artifacts. Conduct continuous
synthetic canary tests for 60 minutes.
